natural_body: Targeted 40% discounts boost acquisition but sharply damage retention.

first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation messaging improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful action. Memory_86 shows shortened onboarding improved completion and time-to-value. Rather than chase price-sensitive segments with promotional_pricing (memory_73 shows 40% discounts damage retention sharply), or referral_incentive (which works well for established customers, not acquisition into declining activation), activation_messaging targets the core problem directly: we're losing engagement momentum at critical early moments. This preserves margin, aligns with sustainable revenue, and leverages proven lift without the retention damage of discounting. Verifying memory_91 and memory_86 to confirm the magnitude of their effects and any interaction patterns before rolling out messaging improvements to new cohorts.
